tank_description: A lone-wolf Marksman built for fast ambush tactics, the Leo 2FK combines excellent speed and acceleration with several unique trick cards to outplay its opponents. Armed with an auto-reloading ATGM launcher, it is a quiet but deadly threat to any enemy caught unaware.

strengths.title: Mobility
strengths.description: The Leopard 2FK is a nimble marksman, which greatly aids its playstyle. Featuring a good top speed and all around good acceleration, players will find this vehicle exceptionally easy to move around the battlefield and seek out advantageous positions.

strengths.title: Base Damage
strengths.description: Leopard 2FK features a heavy hitting main gun. Firing guided missiles instead of a standard tank round. If aimed well, these missiles are devastating, combining a heavy hitting crit with a good damage cone, both resulting in a high base damage with devastating crit potential.

strengths.title: Autoreloader
strengths.description: The main gun on the Leopard 2FK features a ‘passive reload’ feature, meaning that you’re constantly reloading spent ammunition over time. This allows players who manage their ammo well to maintain good uptime and making sure they are always ready to strike.

strengths.title: LOS Jammer
strengths.description: A powerful tool in your arsenal, Leopard 2FK has the ability "vanish" and thereby giving 'the raspberry' to any vehicle that tries to look at it, making you significantly harder to hit and gives you the option to press the fight or to choose flight.

strengths.title: Feign Death
strengths.description: A unique skill, the ability to 'play dead'. When used correctly the ‘Feign Death’ ability can be an extremely effective tool. Faking your death at a critical moment and in the heat of battle can give you a crucial edge and a high alpha ambush shot on an unsuspecting opponent.

weaknesses.title: Survivability
weaknesses.description: The Leopard 2FK features many critical weak spots from almost all angles. Your ammo, fuel and engine are all extremely vulnerable to even light weapons. Keep your distance and watch your position at all times. The Leo 2FK makes for a poor sustained brawler.

weaknesses.title: Projectile Velocity
weaknesses.description: Your main weapon, the ATGM, can take a considerable amount of time to cover the distance to your enemy. Due to the weapon needing to be guided all the way to the target. Players will often find themselves open to easy return fire with limited ability to react.

weaknesses.title: Damage Per Minute
weaknesses.description: Despite the passive autoloading. In a sustained engagement you will quickly find yourself empty of missiles. As a result, the impressive opening DPM will begin to deplete. Manage your resources carefully or find yourself without options.

weaknesses.title: Limited Utility
weaknesses.description: Leopard 2FK is a one-trick pony and very much of a lone wolf, it has very little direct ability to support allies or assist directly in an engagement. As a result Leo 2FK’s will often find themselves playing around their team, rather than with which can be a point of frustration to some.

weaknesses.title: Feign Death
weaknesses.description: A positive and a negative. This ability, despite having its uses, will be unlikely to fool an experienced player. As a result the effectiveness of this ability drops exponentially as players progress into higher skill brackets.

tank_summary: The Leo 2FK is a highly mobile and agile tank, boasting a good top speed, strong acceleration, and excellent traverse capabilities. Its primary armament is a potent missile launcher, capable of delivering precise, high damage-per-minute (DPM) attacks if aimed skillfully. A unique "passive reload" system ensures constant ammunition replenishment, rewarding players who manage their resources effectively.

While devastating in the right hands, the Leo 2FK has very poor survivability. Thin protection and numerous critical weak spots leave its engine, fuel, and ammunition vulnerable, while the missiles' slow travel time can expose it to return fire if caught in the open.

The Leo 2FK is largely a "lone wolf" vehicle, excelling in ambush due to its high initial alpha damage, which can be devastating. Its design emphasizes ambushing engagements, with players to fire a few shots and then retreat to avoid return fire. The tank's limited ability to directly support allies means it operates more around its team rather than within the core of engagements.
